placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
Behind the red door, the Red Lodge tells the story of a building that has served very different purposes over four centuries. The Great Oak Room is a chance to slow down and look closely at the details of an Elizabethan interior.

Our family idea: ask children to spot patterns in the room, then look for shapes in the garden. Keep the visit unhurried and choose a few details to talk about together.
